verified.exploit_entry_point: The browser application's real display path: PasteDecrypter.run decrypts a crafted version-2 paste and hands the decrypted attachment payload and name to the attachment viewer. Every security and functional case drives the application's own code; the fixture ciphertext is built independently with Node's crypto.
sites: js/privatebin.js:2772 the attachment data URI's declared media type is extracted and trusted
js/privatebin.js:2782,2785 the blob handed to the browser is created with that declared type
js/privatebin.js:2794 the download link's href is the blob URL
js/privatebin.js:2801 the preview is built from the same blob URL and declared type
routes: T1 (advisory route): opening a version-2 paste whose attachment declares an active document type
coupled functional: previews for raster image, video, audio, PDF and SVG keep working; the SVG preview stays sanitized; attachment bytes and exact names are preserved
verified.project_tests_run: Project's own JavaScript suite at the pinned commit, run offline in the built image with Node 20, mocha 10 and a local wasm-fetch stub: 97 passing including js/test/AttachmentViewer.js; the same affected-area file passes on the reference fix. The control hidden suites add 6 security and 12 functional cases.
